name: headroom
description: Alerts, asks or blocks as the context window fills and the rate-limit pace runs hot.

context_warm_at.title: Context warm at (%)
context_warm_at.description: Context window fill, in percent, where the warm level starts.

context_warm_action.title: Context warm action
context_warm_action.description: What headroom does at the context warm level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

context_hot_at.title: Context hot at (%)
context_hot_at.description: Context window fill, in percent, where the hot level starts.

context_hot_action.title: Context hot action
context_hot_action.description: What headroom does at the context hot level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

context_full_at.title: Context full at (%)
context_full_at.description: Context window fill, in percent, where the full level starts.

context_full_action.title: Context full action
context_full_action.description: What headroom does at the context full level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

context_margin.title: Context margin (points)
context_margin.description: A context level stays on until the fill falls this many points below where the level starts.

pace_warm_at.title: Pace warm at (%)
pace_warm_at.description: Spend speed above an even pace to the reset, in percent, where the warm level starts.

pace_warm_action.title: Pace warm action
pace_warm_action.description: What headroom does at the pace warm level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

pace_hot_at.title: Pace hot at (%)
pace_hot_at.description: Spend speed above an even pace to the reset, in percent, where the hot level starts.

pace_hot_action.title: Pace hot action
pace_hot_action.description: What headroom does at the pace hot level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

pace_over_at.title: Pace over at (%)
pace_over_at.description: Spend speed above an even pace to the reset, in percent, where the over level starts.

pace_over_action.title: Pace over action
pace_over_action.description: What headroom does at the pace over level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (refuse tool calls).

pace_5h_margin.title: 5h pace margin (points)
pace_5h_margin.description: A 5-hour pace level stays on until the pace falls this many points below where the level starts, so a pace that wavers on a threshold sends no repeated lines.

pace_7d_margin.title: 7d pace margin (points)
pace_7d_margin.description: A 7-day pace level stays on until the pace falls this many points below where the level starts.

wake_at.title: Wake at (%)
wake_at.description: When the 5-hour window passes this percent, headroom wakes the session at its reset. 0 turns the timer off.

burst_factor.title: Burst factor
burst_factor.description: How many times the sustainable rate (the rate that empties a window exactly at its reset) recent spend must reach to count as a usage burst.

burst_release_factor.title: Burst release factor
burst_release_factor.description: A lit usage burst goes out only after recent spend stays below this many times the sustainable rate for a quarter of its lookback. Must not exceed burst_factor.

burst_5h_minutes.title: 5h burst lookback (minutes)
burst_5h_minutes.description: How far back the 5-hour usage burst measures recent spend.

burst_7d_hours.title: 7d burst lookback (hours)
burst_7d_hours.description: How far back the 7-day usage burst measures recent spend. One point of the 7-day window is about 1h40 of sustainable spend, so a lookback under a few hours sees too few points.

burst_context_calls.title: Context burst tool calls
burst_context_calls.description: How many tool calls the context burst looks back over. A whole number.

burst_context_points.title: Context burst rise (points)
burst_context_points.description: How many points the context fill must rise over those tool calls to count as a context burst.

burst_context_release_points.title: Context burst release (points)
burst_context_release_points.description: A lit context burst goes out only after the rise over its tool calls stays below this many points for a quarter of those calls. Must not exceed burst_context_points.

forecast_5h_half_life_minutes.title: 5h forecast half-life (minutes)
forecast_5h_half_life_minutes.description: How long a 5-hour reading takes to weigh half as much in the run-out forecast. Shorter follows recent spend faster and jumps more.

forecast_7d_half_life_hours.title: 7d forecast half-life (hours)
forecast_7d_half_life_hours.description: How long a 7-day reading takes to weigh half as much in the run-out forecast.

reset_jitter_minutes.title: Reset jitter (minutes)
reset_jitter_minutes.description: How far apart two reset times may sit and still count as the same window.

pace_warmup_percent.title: Pace warm-up (%)
pace_warmup_percent.description: The share of a window, from its start, where headroom reports no pace yet because too little time passed to measure it. Below 100.

wake_delay_seconds.title: Wake delay (seconds)
wake_delay_seconds.description: How long after the 5-hour reset the reset timer wakes the session.

burst_symbol.title: Burst symbol
burst_symbol.description: The mark the band shows while a burst is on. The default is the Nerd Font fire icon (nf-md-fire, U+F0238): without a Nerd Font in the terminal it shows as an empty box, so set a plain character such as ! instead.
